#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Hot reload library module (vestigial shebang; imported, not an entry script)."""


class HotReloader:
    def start_watching(self, source_file: str) -> None:
        print(f"[HOT RELOAD] Watching {source_file} for changes...")

    def _watch_loop(self) -> None:
        print("[HOT RELOAD] Detected changes")
